label: practice

test_cases.label: length() on empty and populated list
test_cases.code:
lst = LinkedList()
assert lst.length() == 0
for x in [3, 1, 2, 6]: lst.insert(x)
assert lst.length() == 4

test_cases.label: to_list() preserves self and returns sorted list
test_cases.code:
lst = LinkedList()
assert lst.to_list() == []
for x in [1, 2, 1, 6]: lst.insert(x)
assert lst.to_list() == [1, 1, 2, 6]
assert lst.to_list() == [1, 1, 2, 6]

test_cases.label: __str__() formats '()', '(3)', '(2, 3, 4)'
test_cases.code:
lst = LinkedList()
assert str(lst) == '()'
lst.insert(3)
assert str(lst) == '(3)'
lst.insert(2)
lst.insert(4)
assert str(lst) == '(2, 3, 4)'
